reviews_captured_by_me.text:
Danny did a wonderful job on our kitchen ! He helped us put our new stove top, oven in and he trimmed our cabinet so the new refrigerator would fit.  Also we bought the granite sink from his shop and it's been the best sink I've owned.  It's been about a year and a half since the work was done and everything still looks so good.  I just finished painting my cabinets finally and they look so good with the countertop Danny installed.  I highly recommend Danny's Top Shop 😸
Thank you Danny !

We selected Danny's for our new counters and sink largely because we saw the quality of his work at our church kitchen and school library. He was fast, efficient and the quality of the finished product was excellent. Looking forward to having him work at our house. His office Manager Sarah has been on top of the project communicating with us every step of the way.  Can't wait to see how this all works out.

QUALITY PRODUCTS& SERVICES CONSISTANTLY FOR DECADES!! So many people now have no idea what REAL customer service is. The Mega-Corps & Big Box Chains has swallowed up the small businesses and their extensive knowledge and expertise behind.
But DANNY'S TOP SHOP'S SERVICE & PRODUCTS HAVE GONE UNMATCHED FOR DECADES BECAUSE HE SHARES HIS KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERTISE TO HELP YOU GET YOUR PROJECT DONE RIGHT WITH HONESTY A, PROFESSIONALISM AND PROMPT ATTENTION TO DETAIL.   GET IT RIGHT THE FIRST TIME CALL OR GO SEE DANNY.
NO SURPRISES. REAL CUSTOMER SERVICE!!
